thread:
maria: Heads up — Altair partner asked to open a new marketplace region for them: eu-west-3-altair. They want dedicated quota and a soft QoS SLO for the first 90 days.
aj: +1. Do we have their SKU list and expected steady-state RPS?
altair-rep (via DM to maria): baseline 50 rps, burst to 300 for short promos, prefer 4xA100-equivalent vGPU per zone. MID-8734 is the marketplace listing id.
kevin: OK. For capacity planning we'll need quota tickets to the cloud provider and an ops approval. Can you paste the exact SKU IDs?
maria: SKU IDs: ALT-ML-100A, ALT-ML-200B. I'll drop the CSV in the partner drive. Also asked for KMS integration (customer-managed) and private VPC peering.
sophia: KMS + VPC peering ok, but legal needs to sign the connector annex. timeline?
maria: Partner asked for go-live in 6 weeks (target 2026-05-12). They said legal review can be prioritized.
harry: Product: we need to gate the listing behind a QoS test. Can eng run a smoke benchmark on a small reserved pool? If it passes, we flip the listing to enabled.
aj: I'll own the smoke bench. Can someone open a Dedicated reservation for a trial pool (2x A100 equiv) in eu-west-3?
kevin: Opening internal ticket ENG-9931 for reserved pool provisioning. @sophia can you approve the quota request once I attach the provider form?
sophia: Approved in principle. Need completed provider quota form and expected monthly token/instance counts to file.
maria: Sharing numbers now: expected tokens/mo ~ 1.2B, instances steady 4, burst pool up to 12. CSV link: https://drive.redwood/partners/altair/eu-west-3/capacity.csv
marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing MID-8734 state changed: draft -> pending-capacity-check :white_check_mark:
kevin: Filed cloud provider quota ticket Q-452778 with attachments (provider form + CSV). ETA from provider ~ 5 business days.
harry: Legal: @maria please loop in legal for connector annex and SOC review. We can't enable private VPC until signed.
maria: On it — legal pinged (cc: @harry). Also coordinating a joint press window; partner requests announcement 1 week after go-live. We'll confirm after capacity + KMS sign-off.
aj: Bench steps in ENG-9931: 1) bootstrap 2 instances, 2) run perf harness (link in ticket), 3) run failover test between zones. I expect 48h to complete once pool is up.
kevin: Noted. If provider quota comes through earlier we can speed up. I'll post updates in this thread.
sophia: Also check IP allowlist rules for their SI integrations — they need 3 static egress IPs. Provider may charge for static NATs.
maria: Partner OK with charges as long as we flag on invoice. Finance asked for estimated incremental monthly cost. @kevin can you draft a rough cost calc?
kevin: Drafting now — will attach in ENG-9931 by EOD.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: upcoming compliance window — SOC artifact refresh due in 14 days.
harry: Summary action items: maria -> legal + partner comms; aj -> bench; kevin -> quota ticket + cost calc; sophia -> KMS/VPC sign-off. We all reconvene when quota ticket updates. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all, will update once legal signs connector annex or provider returns quota.
kevin: update: provider responded (Q-452778) — provisional capacity approved for ALT-ML-100A x4, ALT-ML-200B x2. Waiting final confirmation.
maria: Great, keeping the promo window flexible. Will post final go/no-go once bench passes. :rocket:
